newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 3.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 3.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- President Arpad Goncz has concerns over several points of the conflict of interest bill and sent it back to the Parliament for rethinking the bill.
- SZDSZ, the junior party of the ruling coalition said that the draft of the new constitution should be worked out even if three opposition parties do not support that work.
- The welfare minister begins investigation in the case of a girl who was shot on the throat with a bow and received medical care with a large delay.
- The opposition Smallholders' Party (FKGP) said that the recent amendments on the privatisation contracts of Budapest Bank showed that bad state contracts can be reviewed.
